items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Teddy Weatherford; the interviewer mentions him, but the interviewee responds by discussing Dave Payton and Oiskin Tate, indicating no personal connection or direct interaction with Weatherford is described.

ctx.x: Well they had regular jazz music then. It was a jazz world and it was really a jazz music. The rest of the people copied from those bands then, you know, they picked it up from those bands. And so they had all the fellas, this is Dave, this is Oiskin Tate, was a very famous band playing at that time. You heard talk of him?
Sure. Did you? Teddy Weatherford? What? What I was saying. Wonderful piano player. I got a record by them, with Louis on the cornet.

Dave Payton, you heard Dave Payton. Joe Oliver used to play with him after Joe broke up his band. You heard of him in front of them. What the shit you said? Dave Payton and Oiskin Tate, he was director at the Vendome Theatre.
